headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a thrilling 4-6 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, while the Miami Marlins shut down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0. The Chicago Cubs took down the Washington Nationals 8-6, and the Seattle Mariners fell short in a 1-4 decision to the New York Yankees.

Injuries are piling up across the league, with several key players landing on the injured list. The Colorado Rockies have placed third baseman Kyle Karros on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Other notable injuries include José Suarez (Athletics) with a right hip strain, Blake Treinen (Los Angeles Dodgers) with right elbow inflammation, and Jameson Taillon (Toronto Blue Jays) with right forearm tendinits.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Baltimore Orioles acquiring center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 4-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers outlasted the Cleveland Guardians in a back-and-forth matchup, securing a 4-6 win. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Pirates in 2-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, with Eury Pérez earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless baseball. Esteury Ruiz led the Pirates' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall Short in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dropped a 1-4 decision to the New York Yankees in their latest matchup. Randy Arozarena led the Mariners at the plate with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Karros on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have placed third baseman Kyle Karros on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Rivas Traded to Orioles in Latest MLB Deal**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The deal is part of the larger Adley Rutschman trade, with a player to be named later still to be determined.
